item: scripts/sweep_pr_number.py writes the real PR number over the placeholders in the ledger fragments the branch added, once the PR exists
summary: Writes the real PR number over `PR pending` / `#NNNN` in the ledger fragments this branch added (`git merge-base BASE HEAD`, `--diff-filter=A --no-renames`; a fragment already on the base is never touched): in lessons.d and shipped_log.d prose outside fences and `inline code`, and in the shipped.d `refs` cell only, found the way csv reads a record so every other cell stays byte-identical (40 of the 527 shipped.d fragments on main are not in the csv writer's own form, so a parse-edit-write would have rewritten them). Refuses, writing nothing, on a number that is not a positive integer, a base that does not resolve, a branch that added no fragment, a symlink, non-UTF-8 text, a csv that is not the header plus one row, a rewrite that would change any cell but refs, or a placeholder it has no rule for; --dry-run prints and writes nothing; a second run says there is nothing to sweep and exits 0. Evidence: tests/test_sweep_pr_number.py (31 cases, each run against a throwaway git repository with the bytes compared) with 23 of 23 mutants of the script killed (the mutant harness is kept under export-lane/, not in the repo), and a run on fragments made by the real lessons.py, ledger_fold.py new-log and ledger_shipped.py tools, after which `ledger_fold.py check` and `ledger_shipped.py check` pass. Limits: it reads what the branch has COMMITTED as added and rewrites the working-tree copy; origin/main is whatever the clone last fetched; no CI step runs it on a real PR (the tests run it on throwaway repositories), so a token ledger_fold._PLACEHOLDER learns later needs its line in _RULES (until then the script names the surviving token and refuses).
